validity.researcher_notes: The scope brief's watchlist asked whether P7363 'Ras Ghareb-Asyut LPG Pipeline' (305 km) is a segment/duplicate of P7364 'Ras Bakr-Ras Gharb-Asyut LPG Pipeline' (160 km). The SAME source article that is P7363's sole citation answers this directly, in the same paragraph: it names the 305 km 'Ras Ghareb-Asyut' butagas line as a project ALREADY COMPLETED, and separately names a 160 km 'doubling' (ازدواج, i.e. laying a second/parallel line) of a 'Ras Bakr-Ras Ghareb-Asyut' butagas line as NEARING COMPLETION at time of writing (Apr 2019) -- along with a THIRD, still-only-planned 130 km doubling of a 'Ras Ghareb-Khashm El-Raqaba' butagas line, and a connection of SUMED's Sokhna LPG facilities into the national LPG grid. PPC itself is tracking these as separate, differently-named, differently-staged infrastructure projects in one breath, not describing one pipeline twice. This is corroborating context from the row's own citation, not an independent second source, so it doesn't raise the corroboration tier -- but it does resolve the duplicate question: no merge is warranted between P7363 and P7364.
